assumptions: One-off spend S (default 20) at start of year 1, on top of canonical FY26 held flat for five years: PAT 50, free cash flow 13 (CFO 58 - capex 45), 10 cr shares. Not part of Ramu canonical accounts.
Scrap value 5% of S (Schedule II ceiling), sold for cash at the end of life L; if capitalised, sold at book value (no gain); if expensed, a gain equal to scrap in year L.
Straight line: (S-R)/L a year. Written-down: fixed rate 1-(R/S)^(1/L) on opening book value.
Tax expense 25% of book profit; cash tax is set by tax law and fixed across choices (difference is deferred tax); any cash tax saving from deducting the spend is left out.
Chart shows years 1-5; a life above 5 is cut off and the ledger shows charge after year 5.
lab.independent_calculation_method: Python closed-form oracle (labtest.py in scratchpad; e_t via q=(R/S)^(1/L) geometric form, not the page loop) driving the page through Playwright and reading window.labResults; static drawings computed by a separate generator (svgs.py).

cases.name: full grid S 0..40 step 5 x L 2..10 x cap/exp x SL/WDV

invariants: total charged to profit over life == net cash out == S - 5% S for every setting (324 cases)
cash after spend identical across treatment and method for every setting
spend 0 reproduces canonical PAT 50 and FCF 13
lab.axis_and_clipping: Fixed axis -30..60 (cash minimum 13-40=-27, PAT maximum 51.5); ticks and bars from one scale function; no clipping at any input. Years above 5 are disclosed in the ledger.
